description: This Java class 'CashierTransactionDataValidator' provides validation methods for cashier transactions within the Fineract platform, including cash settlement, cashier date range checks, and on-loan disbursal validation.

classes.name: CashierTransactionDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for cashier transaction operations, including cash settlement, cashier date range validation, and on-loan disbursal validation.

methods.name: validateSettleCashAndCashOutTransactions
methods.description: Validates if the transaction amount does not exceed the cashier's net cash balance.

methods.name: validateSettleCashAndCashOutTransactions
methods.description: Overloaded method that extracts parameters from JsonCommand and calls the main validation method.

methods.name: validateCashierAllowedDateAndTime
methods.description: Checks if the cashier's date range is within the teller’s date range and if the cashier is already allocated during the specified time.

methods.name: validateOnLoanDisbursal
methods.description: Validates if a staff member's on-loan disbursal is within their cashier's date and time range.
